name: Bench Dips
instructions: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair or bench, hands gripping the edge beside your hips, legs extended in front of you. This is the starting position.
Slowly lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping elbows pointing back.
Push through your triceps to lift yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
